attempt_identity: E4-0 Track B v02 successor source/synthetic validation

details: A wildcard import from unchanged e4_gpu_lease_v01 re-exported e4_runner_common_v01 names into e4_runner_modes_v02. That caused its online preflight to call the V01 contract verifier, defeating V06 contract identity validation.
The same wildcard re-export caused synthetic GPU lease/resource errors to use the V01 E4RunnerError class while V02 tests expected the V02 class.
